scoring_justification: The fraction of LiHPs with K*_Li-Li > 1 can be recomputed directly from the CSV columns (is_lihp, K_star_LiLi) without re-running any simulation, qualifying for T1 recompute.

outputs.description: Per-lithium data: propensity, normalized Li-Li and Li-O kinetic correlations, and LiHP flag. The fraction of LiHPs with K_star_LiLi > 1 is extracted and compared to the paper-reported reference.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker will read this CSV, validate the columns, compute the fraction of rows where is_lihp is True and K_star_LiLi > 1.0, and compare to the paper’s reported value (~0.85) with an appropriate tolerance. An optional secondary check may verify that the fraction of LiHPs with K_star_LiO > 1.0 is not predominantly above average.

hidden_assets.purpose: Target fraction of LiHPs with nearest-Li normalized correlation > 1 (approximately 0.85 from paper).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Results text: 'about 85% of the high mobile LiHP is correlated with their first neighbors' (Fig. 5).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from explicit statement in the paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly quoted from the paper's reported result; used as the gold for a proportional claim.

steps.description: Compute the fraction of LiHP ions (is_lihp==True) that exhibit above-average nearest-lithium normalized correlation (K_star_LiLi > 1). Compare against the paper-reported value of 0.85 with a tolerance.
Verify that the fraction of LiHPs with above-average nearest-oxygen normalized correlation (K_star_LiO > 1) is not predominantly above average (≤ 0.5).
